execution.reason: Supervisor 8.78 forbids spawning duplicate self-hosted experiments while the frozen structural and recovery runs remain queued; this addendum changes no executable scientific source.

finding.observation: The generator's polarity=(scenario+target_index)%2 rule makes NEGATIVE probe queries negated in 2/3 cases while AFFIRMATIVE and NEUTRAL are negated in only 1/3 cases. The current unit test verifies only that both Boolean values occur for every target; it does not require target and query polarity to be statistically independent.
finding.residualization_gap: QUERY_POLARITY is not one of the four required nuisance families (CANONICAL_LABEL_LEXEME, SEMANTIC_SYNONYM_LEXICON, GENERIC_INSTRUCTION_COMPLIANCE, OUTPUT_CODE_IDENTITY). Therefore calibration class means may retain a probe-polarity component even after the current nuisance projection.
finding.claim_boundary: This source-level confound does not prove that the queued native causal result will fail or that a future PASS is entirely explained by polarity. Opaque output-code rotation and the causal matrix reduce the plausibility of a pure polarity-only explanation. It does mean the current 9-case design cannot by itself establish a fully counterbalanced target-internal-state axis free of probe-polarity information.

successor_factorial.name: TARGET_X_CODE_X_QUERY_POLARITY_COMPLETE_FACTORIAL
successor_factorial.construction: Use three Latin-square output-code mappings crossed with two independent probe-polarity phases. For every semantic target and every opaque code A/B/C, include exactly one positive-query and one negated-query probe.
required_invariants: Every target x output_code x query_polarity cell occurs exactly once or an equal preregistered replicate count.
Target-query-polarity mutual information is exactly zero by construction before model execution.
Calibration and holdout remain lexically disjoint outside the frozen structural whitelist.
No canonical semantic labels or listed synonyms are model-facing.
Demo polarity scheduling is independently counterbalanced so probe polarity cannot be inferred from a global phase token/format shortcut.
Output-code identity remains exactly counterbalanced within every target and polarity stratum.
Add a deterministic regression that fails if any target has unequal positive/negated counts or if any target x code pair lacks both polarities.
successor_factorial.defense_in_depth_control: Report an explicit matched QUERY_POLARITY nuisance/control contrast on calibration and holdout even though the complete factorial should make it orthogonal by design; do not tune the semantic vector or gain on holdout using this control.
